sources.excerpt: Reference shows exploded male/female cable connector with keyed mating interface and labels Direct (objective/format/security), Anchor (model version state), Throttle (cadence and budget), Audit (append-only telemetry logging). sources.reference: ChatGPT conversation · 2026-10-17 · “perfect this fix our draft deck problems”
sources.excerpt: Selected concept headline: Constraints make an interface executable. Four callouts: 01 Define — Objective, format, security; 02 Anchor — Model and version; 03 Bound — Cadence and budget; 04 Record — Execution trace. Reflection: Which constraint must be explicit before these parts can connect? Scope: Keying illustrates fit. Software controls still require implementation and testing. Approval applies to the concept, not proof of the later editable reconstruction.
